part1.title: What If Earth Flew Through a Comet's Tail? ☄️ Part 1 #shorts
part1.description:
A new comet's tail holds poison gas, and Earth passes through it on Friday. In May 1910, Earth flew through Halley's Comet's tail.
An original animated "What if...?" story by zylo, part 1 of 8.

Follow for a new "What if...?" every day.

full.title: What If Earth Flew Through a Comet Tail Today? (Full Story)
full.description:
In May 1910, Earth flew through the tail of Halley's Comet. Its gas made headlines, people bought anti-comet pills, and nothing happened. What if it happened today?
